name: DubStarMooniCon
description: Two-oscillator subharmonic voice with optional polyphony. The first oscillator spreads across four voices, each with its own divider chain; the second stays monophonic for a stable low end. Eight stepped subharmonic taps in 3-limit ratios, five band-limited waveforms, a resonant state-variable filter and a per-voice ADSR. Pitch is set by stepped selectors only, so there is nothing to tune by ear.
author: Moongriffin
